reason: The deal itself is fair, half on results is more than most agencies offer, but I get three or four of these pitches a week and they all promise meetings. I might take the free sample, but I won't put EUR 1,500 in front of my partner this month on the strength of a LinkedIn message and one logistics case study.
objection: The 45-meeting case was a logistics company, not a wholesaler. My buyers are a small, conservative crowd who buy from people they know, and I doubt cold emails in their language will turn into real buying conversations rather than polite calls that just tick the 'qualified' box.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15-company sample names buyers I actually want and don't already know, and a past client in wholesale or distribution tells me on the phone that those meetings turned into orders, I could take that to my partner and get a yes.
